high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "astrofabric." The post features an aerial view of Tokyo, Japan, taken from a plane. The cityscape is densely packed with buildings, and a river runs through the middle of the urban area. In the distance, a prominent mountain labeled "Mt. Fuji" is visible, indicating that the photo was taken from a location near Tokyo. The text overlay on the image reads: "This is what Tokyo, the largest city on Earth looks like from a plane.
